messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: maria@investorpartners.com
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 OKR kickoff: proposed objectives and request for sign-off

Team —

Attached is the draft Q2 OKR set I pulled together with product and ops inputs (attachment: Q2_OKRs_draft.xlsx). High-level plan: we keep 3 company OKRs, align engineering and product KRs to measurable outcomes, and lock by EOD Friday so we can publish in the all-hands next week.

Agenda for this thread:
- Review the company-level objectives (A,B,C) and KRs under each.
- Call out any capacity or deliverability objections (esp. infra/runtime work).
- Get explicit sign-off or redlines by 48 hours.

Particular asks:
- Laura: confirm metric baselines for adoption & retention KRs (I marked the cells where I made assumptions).
- Steph: feasibility on the infra throughput and latency KRs — if we can’t hit the target, propose a fallback KR.
- Markus: any hiring or resourcing constraints for Q2 we should call out.

I included a short rationale doc (Q2_kpi_rationale.pdf) that ties each KR to customer/business impact. If we don’t hear objections, I will lock these and prepare the canonical Google Doc for sign-off on Friday.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Product Strategy | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q2_OKRs_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets)
Attachment: Q2_kpi_rationale.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 10:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 OKR kickoff: proposed objectives and request for sign-off

Jonas —

Thanks for pulling this together. Quick notes after a pass through the spreadsheet:

1) Objective A (Grow product-led signups): KR A2 lists a 20% activation bump from onboarding flows. Our baseline measurement was lower than the spreadsheet assumes — I updated the baseline cell and suggested a KR of +15% instead of +20% (sheet cell comment). If the team is confident on the experiments, we can leave 20 but would like a short note explaining the growth hypothesis.

2) Objective B (Improve inference economics): The suggested KR for p50 latency drop looks aggressive given scheduled infra upgrades. Recommend splitting into two KRs: one for p50 (-10%) and one for unit-cost per 1M tokens (-8%). That preserves both latency and cost signals.

3) Objective C (Enterprise readiness): Add a sub-KR for audit readiness — SOC2 evidence checklist completion by May 15.

I’m comfortable with the overall set pending the two edits above. I’ll join a short sync if helpful.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Management | Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 OKR kickoff: proposed objectives and request for sign-off

Thanks — good set. A few operational notes from Eng:

- On infra upgrades: the baseline for the p50 latency change needs to account for the regional rollout in mid-May. I support Laura’s split into latency + cost KRs; otherwise we conflate work we can’t fully control.
- Throughput KR: the current KR asks for a 25% throughput increase; that’s deliverable only if we prioritize GPU packing and batching changes. If we keep that KR, we should mark it as conditional on a dedicated project (I added a comment in the doc).
- Hiring: we expect two SRE hires to land by June; those should be reflected under resourcing assumptions.

If the leadership team is locking Friday, please ensure the engineering dependencies page is linked in the final doc so teams can start planning.

— Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
VP Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

All —

Checked resourcing and ramp timelines. Two quick points:
1) The design team has a major initiative in late May; if product expects UI/UX heavy experiments, we should push the activation KR target timeline later or commit additional design FTEs.
2) I concur on the SOC2 evidence KR — ops needs a hard date so we can prioritize the checklist.

I don’t have further edits. +1 to locking by Friday if Laura and Steph are happy with the tweaks.

Markus

Team —

Thanks for the quick reviews and pragmatic feedback. I incorporated Laura’s baseline adjustments, split the latency/cost KR as Steph suggested, and added the SOC2 evidence sub-KR with a May 15 deadline. The updated canonical doc is here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aQ2zQ2Q2qQ2Q2/edit (also attached to the Drive link).

Please reply to this thread with a single-line Ack ("Ack" or "Approve") by EOD today if you agree. If anyone needs a conversation instead of a reply, ping me and I’ll set a 30-minute slot.

If we get full sign-off I’ll publish the Q2 OKRs to the company page and schedule a 20-minute all-hands highlight next Tue.

Thanks — Jonas
